question.prompt: Each third-grade classroom at Pearl Creek Elementary has \(18\) students and \(2\) pet rabbits. How many more students than rabbits are there in all \(4\) of the third-grade classrooms?

solutions.explanation:
Each classroom has \(18-2=16\) more students than rabbits. All four classrooms have this same difference, so the total difference is
\[4\cdot16=64.\]
There are \(\boxed{64}\) more students than rabbits, choice C.
solutions.title: Find the difference in each classroom
